name: Nickel Slot Blitz Creeper (Simulated Pressure)
coverage: Cover 3 Match Creeper (4-Man Rush, 7 in Coverage)

summary.motive: Manufacture free edge pressure with only a 4-man rush by dropping a defensive end into coverage while sending a lightning-fast slot defensive back.
summary.keyDefender: NICKEL (unblocked slot blitzer) & WDE (creeper flat dropper)
summary.whyItWorks: Offensive line slide rules lock onto the 4-down front, leaving the tackle picking up the slanting DE while the DB rushes completely unblocked into the backfield.
summary.failureMode: Quick hot throws directly into the slot void if the safety fails to roll down in time to replace the blitzing nickelback.

beats.title: Standard Over Front Disguise
beats.text: Jesse Minter aligns in a classic 4-down Over front with two-high safeties, giving zero pre-snap indication of pressure.

beats.title: Simulated Exchange: Nickel Fires, WDE Bails
beats.text: At the snap, SDE slants into the B-gap occupying the RT, freeing NICKEL to blitz clean off the edge. Simultaneously, WDE drops into the boundary flat, keeping 7 defenders in coverage.

beats.title: Pass Protection Compromised & Lanes Flooded
beats.text: The LT is left blocking empty air as WDE drops, while the RT is pinned inside by the SDE stunt. 7 coverage defenders suffocate every intermediate throwing window.

beats.title: Free Edge Hitter Forces Strip-Sack
beats.text: NICKEL accelerates untouched off the edge, delivering a blindside hit on the quarterback before he can scan past his first read.

relations.tell: Standard 4-down look where SDE spikes inside to pin the RT while Nickel blitzes from the slot and WDE drops into coverage
